f.title: Have an adequate pharmacovigilance system and include its summary in the MA application
f.statement: The MAH shall have an adequate system to fulfil its pharmacovigilance functions, aimed at monitoring the safety of authorised medicinal products and identifying any change in their benefit-risk balance. A summary of the system shall be included in the marketing authorisation application.
f.clause: Art. 8. Sistema de farmacovigilancia del titular

rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá disponer de un sistema adecuado para el cumplimiento de sus funciones de farmacovigilancia, dirigido a controlar la seguridad de los medicamentos autorizados e identificar cualquier modificación de su relación beneficio-riesgo. Un resumen del mismo deberá incluirse en la solicitud de autorización de comercialización.
rows.location: Art. 8. Sistema de farmacovigilancia del titular
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have an adequate system for the fulfilment of its pharmacovigilance functions, aimed at monitoring the safety of authorised medicinal products and identifying any change in their benefit-risk balance. A summary of it shall be included in the marketing authorisation application.

f.title: Maintain a PSMF and provide a copy to AEMPS within 7 calendar days of request
f.statement: The MAH shall prepare a pharmacovigilance system master file (PSMF). AEMPS may at any time require a copy, which the MAH shall submit within seven calendar days at the latest from receipt of the request. The PSMF shall also be available for inspection.

rows.deadline: 7 calendar days from receipt of the AEMPS request
rows.quote: Elaborar un archivo maestro del sistema de farmacovigilancia. La Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios podrá requerir en todo momento al titular de la autorización de comercialización la presentación de una copia de este archivo, que deberá presentar a más tardar en un plazo de siete días naturales desde la recepción del requerimiento. Asimismo, el archivo maestro del sistema de farmacovigilancia estará disponible con fines de inspección.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Prepare a pharmacovigilance system master file. The Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices may at any time require the marketing authorisation holder to submit a copy of this file, which it shall submit at the latest within seven calendar days from receipt of the request. Likewise, the pharmacovigilance system master file shall be available for inspection purposes.

deadline_rule.applies_to: copy of the PSMF requested by AEMPS

f.title: Audit the PV system periodically and independently; record findings and CAPA in the PSMF
f.statement: The MAH shall perform an independent, periodic audit of its pharmacovigilance system, recording the main findings in the PSMF. Based on them, it shall ensure an appropriate corrective action plan is prepared and implemented; the reference to the audit findings may be removed once the corrective actions are completed.

rows.quote: Realizar una auditoría independiente y periódica de su sistema de farmacovigilancia, recogiendo los resultados principales en el archivo maestro. Basándose en ellos, se asegurará de que se elabore y ejecute un plan de medidas correctoras apropiado, pudiendo eliminar la referencia a los resultados de la auditoría una vez completadas las medidas correctoras.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Carry out an independent and periodic audit of its pharmacovigilance system, recording the main findings in the master file. On the basis of them, it shall ensure that an appropriate corrective action plan is drawn up and implemented, and may remove the reference to the audit findings once the corrective measures have been completed.

f.title: Have an EU QPPV permanently available, residing and operating in the EU
f.statement: The MAH shall permanently and continuously have at its disposal an appropriately qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance in the European Union, who shall reside and carry out his or her activities in the EU and shall be responsible for establishing and maintaining the pharmacovigilance system.

rows.quote: Tener a su disposición de forma permanente y continua a una persona debidamente cualificada responsable de farmacovigilancia en la Unión Europea. Esta persona residirá y realizará sus actividades en la Unión Europea y será responsable del establecimiento y el mantenimiento del sistema de farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Have permanently and continuously at its disposal a duly qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance in the European Union. This person shall reside and carry out his or her activities in the European Union and shall be responsible for the establishment and maintenance of the pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Notify the QPPV's name and contact details to AEMPS and EMA
f.statement: The MAH shall communicate the name and contact details of the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance to AEMPS and to the European Medicines Agency.

rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización comunicará a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios y a la Agencia Europea de Medicamentos el nombre y los datos de contacto de la persona responsable.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall communicate to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices and to the European Medicines Agency the name and contact details of the responsible person.

f.title: Evaluate all information scientifically and take appropriate risk measures
f.statement: The MAH shall scientifically evaluate all information, consider options for minimising and preventing risks, and take appropriate measures where necessary.

rows.quote: Evaluar científicamente toda la información, considerar las opciones para minimizar y prevenir riesgos, y adoptar, de ser necesario, las medidas oportunas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Scientifically evaluate all information, consider the options for minimising and preventing risks, and adopt, where necessary, the appropriate measures.

f.title: Comply with the AEMPS Good Pharmacovigilance Practices for the pharmaceutical industry
f.statement: The MAH shall comply with the Good Pharmacovigilance Practices for the pharmaceutical industry published by AEMPS (national quality standards on the organisation and operation of MAHs, defined in Art. 2.13).

rows.quote: Cumplir con las normas de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia para la industria farmacéutica publicadas por la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios.
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (Spanish industry GVP). Double-check: quote proves duty and modal force; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Comply with the standards of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices for the pharmaceutical industry published by the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices.

f.title: Record electronically all suspected adverse reactions from Spain, the EU and third countries
f.statement: The MAH shall electronically record the suspected adverse reactions occurring in Spain, the EU or a third country of which it becomes aware, whether reported spontaneously by healthcare professionals or citizens or collected during a post-authorisation study.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote: Registrar electrónicamente las sospechas de reacciones adversas que se produzcan en España, en la Unión Europea o en un tercer país de las que tenga conocimiento, tanto las notificadas de forma espontánea por los profesionales sanitarios o ciudadanos como las recogidas durante un estudio posautorización.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Electronically record the suspected adverse reactions occurring in Spain, in the European Union or in a third country of which it has knowledge, both those reported spontaneously by healthcare professionals or citizens and those collected during a post-authorisation study.

f.title: Report ICSRs electronically following EU requirements
f.statement: The MAH shall communicate individual case reports of suspected adverse reactions electronically, following the EU requirements set out in the Commission implementing measures and the EU good pharmacovigilance practice guidelines (Art. 1, second paragraph).

rows.quote: Comunicar por vía electrónica las sospechas de casos individuales de reacciones adversas atendiendo a los requerimientos establecidos en la Unión Europea reflejados en los documentos a los que se hace referencia en el párrafo segundo del artículo 1.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Communicate electronically the suspected individual cases of adverse reactions in accordance with the requirements established in the European Union reflected in the documents referred to in the second paragraph of Article 1.

f.title: Submit serious suspected ADRs (EU and third countries) to EudraVigilance within 15 days
f.statement: The MAH shall send electronically to EudraVigilance all suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in the EU and in third countries within 15 calendar days following the day on which it became aware of them.
f.exceptions: Suspected adverse reactions collected in a clinical trial are reported under the clinical trials legislation (Art. 9.3, last paragraph).

rows.deadline: 15 calendar days following the day of awareness
rows.quote: Todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas graves ocurridas en la Unión Europea y en terceros países, en los quince días naturales siguientes al día en el que haya tenido conocimiento de éstas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: All suspected serious adverse reactions occurring in the European Union and in third countries, within the fifteen calendar days following the day on which it became aware of them.

deadline_rule.clock_start: siguientes al día en el que haya tenido conocimiento de éstas
deadline_rule.applies_to: serious suspected adverse reactions occurring in the EU and third countries

f.title: Submit non-serious EU suspected ADRs to EudraVigilance within 90 days
f.statement: The MAH shall send electronically to EudraVigilance all suspected non-serious adverse reactions occurring in the EU within 90 calendar days following the day on which it became aware of them.

rows.deadline: 90 calendar days following the day of awareness
rows.quote: Todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas no graves ocurridas en la Unión Europea en los noventa días naturales siguientes al día en el que haya tenido conocimiento de éstas.
rows.review_note: Review: origin 'domestic' used for EU-origin cases (EEA scope of the clock). Double-check: quote proves deadline and scope; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: All suspected non-serious adverse reactions occurring in the European Union within the ninety calendar days following the day on which it became aware of them.

deadline_rule.clock_start: siguientes al día en el que haya tenido conocimiento de éstas
deadline_rule.applies_to: non-serious suspected adverse reactions occurring in the EU

f.title: Identify the Spanish autonomous community of the reporter in Spanish ICSRs
f.statement: For suspected adverse reactions reported by healthcare professionals practising in Spain or by citizens in Spain, the MAH shall include information identifying the autonomous community where the healthcare professional practises or where the citizen who reported the case resides.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety system configuration

rows.quote: Para aquellas sospechas de reacciones adversas comunicadas por profesionales sanitarios que ejercen su actividad profesional en España, o por ciudadanos que se encuentran en España, el titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá incluir la información que permita conocer la comunidad autónoma donde ejerce su actividad el profesional sanitario o donde reside el ciudadano que ha informado del caso, respectivamente.
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (Spain-specific ICSR data element). Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For those suspected adverse reactions reported by healthcare professionals practising in Spain, or by citizens who are in Spain, the marketing authorisation holder shall include the information that makes it possible to know the autonomous community where the healthcare professional practises or where the citizen who reported the case resides, respectively.

f.title: Notify AEMPS of suspected ADRs to investigational medicines used in compassionate use
f.statement: The MAH shall notify AEMPS of suspected adverse reactions of which it becomes aware to investigational medicinal products obtained through compassionate use.
f.applicability: Investigational medicinal products supplied through compassionate use in Spain

rows.quote: Notificar a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios las sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos en investigación obtenidos a través de uso compasivo de las que tenga conocimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Notify the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices of the suspected adverse reactions to investigational medicinal products obtained through compassionate use of which it becomes aware.

f.title: Flag suspected ADRs that the reporter attributes to a medication error
f.statement: The MAH shall properly identify suspected adverse reactions which the reporter has explicitly stated are the consequence of a medication error.

rows.quote: Identificar adecuadamente las sospechas de reacciones adversas cuyo notificador haya informado explícitamente que son consecuencia de un error de medicación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Adequately identify the suspected adverse reactions which the reporter has explicitly reported to be the consequence of a medication error.

f.title: Monitor worldwide literature for suspected ADRs and report the cases electronically
f.statement: The MAH shall monitor the worldwide scientific literature to identify suspected adverse reactions associated with an active substance of a medicinal product it holds in Spain, occurring in the EU and in third countries where it holds an MA for a product containing that substance, and report these cases electronically per EU requirements. MAHs are not obliged to report to EudraVigilance suspected ADRs from literature on the EMA-monitored list for active substances on that list.
f.exceptions: Active substances on the EMA list under Art. 27 of Regulation 726/2004: literature cases from journals monitored by EMA need not be reported to EudraVigilance.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Realizar un seguimiento de la bibliografía científica mundial, con el fin de identificar los casos de sospechas de reacciones adversas asociadas a un principio activo de un medicamento del que sea titular en España ocurridas en la Unión Europea, así como en terceros países en los que este titular tenga la autorización de comercialización para un medicamento que contenga ese principio activo. Estos casos se comunicarán por vía electrónica atendiendo a los requerimientos europeos
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Monitor the worldwide scientific literature in order to identify cases of suspected adverse reactions associated with an active substance of a medicinal product of which it is the holder in Spain occurring in the European Union, as well as in third countries in which this holder holds the marketing authorisation for a medicinal product containing that active substance. These cases shall be communicated electronically in accordance with the European requirements

f.title: Establish procedures to obtain accurate, verifiable data and follow up reports
f.statement: The MAH shall establish procedures to obtain accurate and verifiable information enabling scientific evaluation of suspected ADR reports; it shall collect follow-up information when considered necessary by the MAH or by the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System and communicate the updates under Art. 9.3.

rows.quote: Establecer procedimientos para obtener información exacta y verificable que permita la evaluación científica de las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas. Con esta finalidad recabarán información de seguimiento sobre las notificaciones cuando se considere necesario bien por el titular de la autorización de comercialización, bien por el Sistema Español de Farmacovigilancia y comunicarán las actualizaciones de dicha información con arreglo al apartado 3 de este artículo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Establish procedures to obtain accurate and verifiable information allowing the scientific evaluation of reports of suspected adverse reactions. To this end they shall collect follow-up information on the reports when considered necessary either by the marketing authorisation holder or by the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System, and shall communicate the updates of that information in accordance with paragraph 3 of this article.

f.title: Collaborate with the Spanish PV System to detect duplicate reports
f.statement: The MAH shall collaborate with the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System in detecting duplicate reports of suspected adverse reactions.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Colaborar con el Sistema Español de Farmacovigilancia en la detección de notificaciones duplicadas de sospechas de reacciones adversas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Collaborate with the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System in the detection of duplicate reports of suspected adverse reactions.

f.title: Include full narrative text in Spanish as reported, plus an English summary
f.statement: In reports of suspected adverse reactions the MAH shall include the complete descriptive and textual statements in Spanish (Castilian) as reported, together with a summary in English.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety system configuration

rows.quote: Incluir en la notificación de sospechas de reacciones adversas las exposiciones de tipo descriptivo y textual íntegras en castellano tal como se hayan notificado, así como un resumen en inglés.
rows.review_note: Review: national language requirement. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Include in the report of suspected adverse reactions the complete descriptive and textual statements in Castilian Spanish as they were reported, as well as a summary in English.

f.title: Homeopathic products (simplified registration): report harmful incidents immediately
f.statement: Holders of homeopathic medicinal products authorised under Article 57 of Royal Decree 1345/2007 are exempt from establishing a pharmacovigilance system, but shall in all cases immediately inform the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System, through the usual channels, of any incident that caused harm to the patient.
f.applicability: Homeopathic medicinal products authorised under RD 1345/2007 Art. 57
f.exceptions: Exempt from establishing a pharmacovigilance system.

rows.actor: Holder of a homeopathic medicinal product authorised under RD 1345/2007 Art. 57
rows.deadline: Immediately
rows.quote: Los titulares de autorización de comercialización de medicamentos homeopáticos autorizados atendiendo al artículo 57 del Real Decreto 1345/2007, de 11 de octubre, están eximidos de establecer un sistema de farmacovigilancia, pero en todo caso informarán inmediatamente al Sistema Español de Farmacovigilancia de acuerdo con los cauces habituales establecidos al efecto, de cualquier incidente que haya supuesto un daño para el paciente.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Holders of marketing authorisations for homeopathic medicinal products authorised under Article 57 of Royal Decree 1345/2007 of 11 October are exempt from establishing a pharmacovigilance system, but shall in any case immediately inform the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System, through the usual channels established for that purpose, of any incident that has caused harm to the patient.

f.title: Submit PSURs electronically to the EMA PSUR repository
f.statement: The MAH shall submit periodic safety update reports electronically to the repository set up at the European Medicines Agency under Article 25a of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004.

rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá presentar los informes periódicos de seguridad de forma telemática al archivo creado para tal efecto en la Agencia Europea de Medicamentos en virtud del artículo 25 bis del Reglamento (CE) n.º 726/2004
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall submit the periodic safety update reports electronically to the repository created for that purpose at the European Medicines Agency under Article 25a of Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

f.title: Prepare PSURs in the EU format with benefit-risk evaluation and exposure data
f.statement: PSURs shall have the format agreed in the EU and include summaries of relevant benefit and risk data, the results of all studies with an assessment of their potential impact on the MA, a scientific evaluation of the benefit-risk balance, all sales volume data, any prescription data held by the MAH, and an estimate of the number of persons exposed.

rows.quote: Los informes periódicos de seguridad tendrán el formato acordado en la Unión Europea. Estos incluirán resúmenes de los datos pertinentes sobre los beneficios y los riesgos del medicamento, contemplando los resultados de todos los estudios, con una valoración de su posible impacto sobre la autorización de comercialización y una evaluación científica de la relación beneficio-riesgo del medicamento, además de todos los datos relativos al volumen de ventas del medicamento, así como cualquier dato sobre el número de prescripciones en poder del titular de la autorización de comercialización, junto con una estimación del número de personas expuestas al medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Periodic safety update reports shall have the format agreed in the European Union. They shall include summaries of the relevant data on the benefits and risks of the medicinal product, including the results of all studies, with an assessment of their possible impact on the marketing authorisation and a scientific evaluation of the benefit-risk balance of the medicinal product, in addition to all data relating to the volume of sales of the medicinal product, as well as any data on the number of prescriptions held by the marketing authorisation holder, together with an estimate of the number of persons exposed to the medicinal product.

f.title: Submit PSURs immediately on AEMPS request and at the default periodicity
f.statement: PSURs shall be submitted immediately on request of AEMPS and periodically, unless another frequency is set as a condition of the MA: every six months from authorisation until marketing; once marketed, every six months for the first two years after first marketing in any EU country, annually for the following two years, and thereafter every three years. The frequency and dates are set in the MA conditions and are calculated from the date of authorisation.
f.exceptions: Another frequency set as an MA condition, or EU reference date harmonisation (Art. 10.4).

rows.deadline: Immediately on AEMPS request; otherwise 6-monthly, then annual, then 3-yearly unless the MA sets another frequency
rows.quote: La presentación deberá efectuarse inmediatamente a solicitud de la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios, y asimismo, de forma periódica con arreglo a los plazos recogidos en este apartado, siempre que no se haya establecido otra frecuencia como condición para la autorización de comercialización del medicamento. La periodicidad de presentación de los informes será semestral a partir de la autorización y hasta su comercialización. Una vez comercializados se presentarán semestralmente durante los dos primeros años tras la primera comercialización en cualquier país de la Unión Europea y anualmente durante los dos años siguientes. A partir de ese momento, el informe periódico de seguridad se presentará a intervalos de tres años.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Submission shall be made immediately at the request of the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices and, likewise, periodically in accordance with the time limits set out in this paragraph, provided that no other frequency has been established as a condition of the marketing authorisation of the medicinal product. Reports shall be submitted every six months from authorisation until marketing. Once marketed they shall be submitted every six months during the first two years after first marketing in any country of the European Union and annually for the following two years. From then on, the periodic safety update report shall be submitted at three-year intervals.

f.title: Request an MA variation to align PSUR submission with the EU reference date
f.statement: Where PSUR frequency and dates are harmonised according to an EU reference date for products with the same active substance(s), MAHs shall apply for a variation of the authorisation conditions in order to submit PSURs according to the EU reference date.
f.applicability: Products with active substance(s) authorised in more than one EU Member State

rows.quote: Los titulares de autorización de comercialización deberán solicitar una modificación de las condiciones de autorización con el objeto de presentar estos informes periódicos de seguridad según la fecha de referencia de la Unión Europea.
rows.review_note: Review: changes of dates or frequency take effect six months after publication (Art. 10.4(d)); kept in the statement context only. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders shall apply for a variation of the authorisation conditions in order to submit these periodic safety update reports according to the European Union reference date.

f.title: May request a change of EU reference date or PSUR frequency
f.statement: MAHs may ask the competent European authorities to change the EU reference date or the PSUR submission frequency for a product to avoid duplicate assessment, achieve international harmonisation or for public health reasons.

rows.quote: los titulares de autorización de comercialización podrán solicitar a las autoridades europeas competentes un cambio de fecha de referencia de la Unión Europea o de la frecuencia de presentación de los informes periódicos de seguridad de un medicamento con la finalidad de evitar una duplicación de la evaluación, lograr un armonización internacional o por razones de salud pública.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: marketing authorisation holders may request the competent European authorities to change the European Union reference date or the frequency of submission of periodic safety update reports of a medicinal product in order to avoid duplication of assessment, achieve international harmonisation or for public health reasons.

f.title: Comment on the PSUR single assessment report within 30 calendar days
f.statement: In the EU single assessment of PSURs, the MAH has thirty calendar days from receipt of the assessment report to submit its comments, which it shall send to the European Medicines Agency and to the Member State leading the assessment.

rows.deadline: 30 calendar days from receipt of the assessment report
rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización dispondrá de treinta días naturales, desde la recepción del informe de evaluación, para emitir sus observaciones, que enviará a la Agencia Europea de Medicamentos y al país que esté liderando la evaluación.
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted (dispondrá de = has the right to a period to comment). Double-check: quote proves deadline and addressees; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have thirty calendar days from receipt of the assessment report to issue its comments, which it shall send to the European Medicines Agency and to the country leading the assessment.

deadline_rule.clock_start: desde la recepción del informe de evaluación
deadline_rule.applies_to: MAH comments on the PSUR single assessment report

f.title: Apply for MA variations required by PSUR assessment outcomes per the set calendar
f.statement: Where the regulatory measures arising from the PRAC recommendation on the PSUR single assessment require a change to the MA conditions, the MAH shall apply for the corresponding variation according to the calendar established.

rows.deadline: According to the calendar established
rows.quote: En caso de que conlleven la necesidad de modificar las condiciones de autorización, el titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá solicitar la modificación de la autorización de comercialización correspondiente atendiendo al calendario que se establezca.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Where they entail the need to modify the authorisation conditions, the marketing authorisation holder shall apply for the corresponding variation of the marketing authorisation in accordance with the calendar established.

f.title: PSUR exemptions for generics, homeopathics, herbals and well-established use
f.statement: Generic medicinal products, homeopathic products authorised by simplified registration, traditional herbal medicinal products and well-established use products are exempt from submitting PSURs, unless the obligation is imposed as an MA condition, or AEMPS requests them for pharmacovigilance reasons or because PSURs are no longer available for the active substance.
f.applicability: Generics, simplified-registration homeopathics, traditional herbal and well-established use products
f.exceptions: Not exempt where imposed as an MA condition, or requested by AEMPS for PV reasons or because no PSURs are available for the active substance.

rows.quote: Quedan exentos de presentar informes periódicos de seguridad los medicamentos autorizados como genéricos, los medicamentos homeopáticos autorizados a través de un registro simplificado, los medicamentos tradicionales a base de plantas o aquellos de uso médico bien establecido, salvo que se haya impuesto dicha obligación como condición de la autorización de comercialización o en el caso de que la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios lo solicite
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Medicinal products authorised as generics, homeopathic medicinal products authorised through a simplified registration, traditional herbal medicinal products or those of well-established medical use are exempt from submitting periodic safety update reports, unless that obligation has been imposed as a condition of the marketing authorisation or where the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices requests it

f.title: Operate a risk management system for each product applied for after entry into force
f.statement: The MAH shall have a risk management system for each medicinal product for which an MA is applied for from the entry into force of the decree. For already authorised products, AEMPS may require a risk management system if new risks arise that could affect the benefit-risk balance; the MAH may submit comments within thirty calendar days of receipt of the request, and if AEMPS confirms the need, the system is incorporated into the MA.

rows.quote: Disponer de un sistema de gestión de riesgos para cada medicamento para el que se solicite autorización de comercialización a partir de la entrada en vigor del presente real decreto. Para medicamentos ya autorizados, la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios podrá exigir al titular de la autorización de comercialización disponer de un sistema de gestión de riesgos en caso de que aparezcan nuevos riesgos que pudieran afectar a la relación beneficio-riesgo del medicamento. En estos casos el titular de la autorización de comercialización podrá remitir alegaciones en un plazo de treinta días naturales a partir de la recepción de la solicitud.
rows.review_note: Review: the 30-day comment period is a right (podrá) and is left in the statement, no deadline_rule. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Have a risk management system for each medicinal product for which a marketing authorisation is applied for from the entry into force of this royal decree. For medicinal products already authorised, the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices may require the marketing authorisation holder to have a risk management system if new risks appear that could affect the benefit-risk balance of the medicinal product. In these cases the marketing authorisation holder may submit comments within thirty calendar days from receipt of the request.

f.title: Incorporate MA conditions into the RMS, monitor risk minimisation outcomes and update the RMS
f.statement: In relation to the risk management system, the MAH shall incorporate into it the conditions required during the authorisation procedure or afterwards, monitor the outcome of the risk minimisation measures included in it, and update it.

rows.quote: Deberá incorporar al sistema de gestión de riesgos las condiciones exigidas durante el procedimiento de autorización del medicamento o posteriormente. b) Supervisará el resultado de las medidas de minimización de riesgos incluidas en el sistema de gestión de riesgos. c) Actualizará el sistema de gestión de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: It shall incorporate into the risk management system the conditions required during the authorisation procedure of the medicinal product or subsequently. b) It shall monitor the outcome of the risk minimisation measures included in the risk management system. c) It shall update the risk management system.

f.title: Submit the RMP to AEMPS with a summary in Spanish
f.statement: The risk management plan shall be submitted to AEMPS together with a summary of it in Spanish (Castilian), in the format to be established.

rows.quote: El plan de gestión de riesgos se presentará a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios junto con un resumen del mismo en castellano, de acuerdo al formato que se establezca.
rows.review_note: Review: national language addition. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The risk management plan shall be submitted to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices together with a summary of it in Castilian Spanish, in accordance with the format to be established.

f.title: Conduct post-authorisation safety studies required by Member States or the Commission
f.statement: The MAH shall conduct the post-authorisation safety studies required by Member States or the European Commission: as a condition of the MA (with deadlines fixed in the MA where necessary), or after authorisation where concerns arise about the safety of an authorised product. Where this affects more than one product, AEMPS, after consulting PRAC, will invite the MAHs concerned to conduct a joint single study.
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Risk management & minimisation

rows.deadline: As set in the MA where necessary
rows.quote: Realizar los estudios posautorización de seguridad requeridos por los Estados miembros o la Comisión Europea: a) Como condición de la autorización de comercialización. La autorización de comercialización fijará, en caso necesario, los plazos de cumplimiento. b) Con posterioridad a la concesión de una autorización de comercialización, en caso de que aparezcan dudas acerca de la seguridad de un medicamento autorizado.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Conduct the post-authorisation safety studies required by the Member States or the European Commission: a) As a condition of the marketing authorisation. The marketing authorisation shall set, where necessary, the deadlines for compliance. b) After the grant of a marketing authorisation, where doubts arise about the safety of an authorised medicinal product.

f.title: Conduct post-authorisation efficacy studies required by Member States or the Commission
f.statement: The MAH shall conduct post-authorisation efficacy studies required by Member States or the European Commission: as an MA condition where efficacy questions can only be resolved after marketing (deadlines set in the MA where necessary), or after authorisation where understanding of the disease or clinical methodology indicates previous efficacy evaluations might need significant revision.

rows.deadline: As set in the MA where necessary
rows.quote: Realizar los estudios posautorización de eficacia requeridos por los Estados miembros o la Comisión Europea, en las siguientes circunstancias:
rows.review_note: Review: quote limited to the lead-in; circumstances (a) and (b) paraphrased from the following lines of Art. 11.3. Double-check: statement faithful to Art. 11.3(a)-(b); bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Conduct the post-authorisation efficacy studies required by the Member States or the European Commission, in the following circumstances:

f.title: Evaluate benefit-risk continuously and inform AEMPS immediately of new information
f.statement: The MAH shall continuously evaluate the benefit-risk balance of its medicinal products authorised in Spain, immediately communicating to AEMPS any new information that could influence the overall benefit-risk evaluation or could require changes to the SmPC, package leaflet or both.

rows.deadline: Immediately
rows.quote: Realizar una evaluación continua de la relación beneficio-riesgo de los medicamentos que tenga autorizados en España, comunicando inmediatamente a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios toda aquella nueva información que pueda influir en la evaluación global de la relación beneficio-riesgo o que pueda requerir la modificación de la ficha técnica, prospecto o ambos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Carry out a continuous evaluation of the benefit-risk balance of the medicinal products it has authorised in Spain, immediately communicating to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices all new information that may influence the overall evaluation of the benefit-risk balance or that may require modification of the summary of product characteristics, the package leaflet or both.

f.title: Inform AEMPS immediately of restrictions, suspensions or prohibitions in any country
f.statement: The MAH shall immediately communicate to AEMPS any restriction, suspension or prohibition imposed by the competent authorities of any country.

rows.deadline: Immediately
rows.quote: Asimismo, deberá comunicar de forma inmediata a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios cualquier restricción, suspensión o prohibición impuesta por las autoridades competentes de cualquier país.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Likewise, it shall immediately communicate to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices any restriction, suspension or prohibition imposed by the competent authorities of any country.

f.title: Provide benefit-risk reports and sales or prescription data on AEMPS request, fully and on time
f.statement: The MAH shall provide a benefit-risk report when AEMPS requests it, or any additional information AEMPS considers necessary to evaluate the benefit-risk balance, including sales or prescription volume data, and shall respond fully and within the deadlines required.

rows.deadline: Within the time limits set in the request
rows.quote: Suministrar un informe de la relación beneficio-riesgo cuando la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios lo solicite, o cualquier información adicional que la misma considere necesaria para poder evaluar la relación beneficio-riesgo de un medicamento, incluida la información relativa al volumen de ventas o de prescripción del medicamento de que se trate. El titular de la autorización de comercialización responderá de forma completa y en los plazos requeridos a este tipo de solicitudes.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Provide a benefit-risk report when the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices requests it, or any additional information that it considers necessary to evaluate the benefit-risk balance of a medicinal product, including information on the volume of sales or prescriptions of the medicinal product concerned. The marketing authorisation holder shall respond fully and within the required time limits to such requests.

f.title: Implement safety regulatory measures in Spain, including RMP measures
f.statement: The MAH shall carry out in Spain the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons, including those set out in the risk management plan.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote: Llevar a cabo en España las medidas reguladoras adoptadas por razones de seguridad, incluyendo las contempladas en el plan de gestión de riesgos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Carry out in Spain the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons, including those contemplated in the risk management plan.

f.title: Evaluate the impact of safety regulatory measures
f.statement: The MAH shall evaluate the impact of the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons, including, where appropriate, any studies considered necessary.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.quote: Evaluar el impacto de las medidas reguladoras adoptadas por razones de seguridad, incluyendo, en su caso, los estudios que se consideren necesarios.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Evaluate the impact of the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons, including, where appropriate, the studies considered necessary.

f.title: Show the additional monitoring symbol in SmPC, leaflet and HCP materials
f.statement: For medicinal products on the additional monitoring list, the MAH shall include in the SmPC and package leaflet the symbol followed by the sentence and explanation agreed by the EU competent authorities, and shall include information on the additional monitoring status in any material for distribution to healthcare professionals, including material for patients distributed through healthcare professionals.
f.applicability: Products on the list of medicinal products subject to additional monitoring

rows.quote: el titular estará obligado a incluir en la ficha técnica y prospecto el símbolo, seguido de la frase y explicación acordados por las autoridades competentes de la Unión Europea; asimismo, estará obligado a incluir información sobre el estatus de seguimiento adicional en cualquier tipo de material para difusión a los profesionales sanitarios, incluyendo aquellos para su difusión a los pacientes a través de los profesionales sanitarios.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: the holder shall be obliged to include in the summary of product characteristics and package leaflet the symbol, followed by the sentence and explanation agreed by the competent authorities of the European Union; likewise, it shall be obliged to include information on the additional monitoring status in any type of material for distribution to healthcare professionals, including material for distribution to patients through healthcare professionals.

f.title: Inform AEMPS in advance of public communications on PV issues; keep them objective
f.statement: The MAH shall inform AEMPS in advance of any communication addressed to the public on pharmacovigilance matters concerning its medicinal product, and shall ensure the information is presented objectively and is not misleading, without omitting relevant safety information. Disseminating information without respecting these terms is a breach of the pharmacovigilance duty under Art. 101.2.b.14 of Law 29/2006.

rows.deadline: Before the communication is issued
rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización informará previamente a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios de cualquier comunicación dirigida al público sobre cuestiones de farmacovigilancia relativa a su medicamento. Deberá asegurar que la información se presente de manera objetiva y no engañosa, sin omitir información de seguridad relevante.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall inform the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices in advance of any communication addressed to the public on pharmacovigilance issues relating to its medicinal product. It shall ensure that the information is presented objectively and is not misleading, without omitting relevant safety information.

f.title: DHPC: agree text, materials and distribution strategy with AEMPS beforehand
f.statement: When information on safety or risk prevention is to be sent individually to healthcare professionals, the MAH shall agree in advance with AEMPS the text and any complementary material, and agree the communication strategy, which shall include at least the distribution procedure, the timetable and the type of healthcare professional addressed. These obligations also apply to risk minimisation material in RMPs to be made known to HCPs and, through them, to patients.
f.applicability: Individual safety communications to healthcare professionals (DHPC) and RMP risk minimisation material

rows.quote: Acordar previamente con la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios el texto y cualquier otro material complementario. b) Acordar la estrategia de comunicación, la cual incluirá al menos el procedimiento de distribución, el calendario y el tipo de profesional sanitario al que debe ir dirigida.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Agree in advance with the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices the text and any other complementary material. b) Agree the communication strategy, which shall include at least the distribution procedure, the timetable and the type of healthcare professional to whom it is to be addressed.

f.title: DHPC: report the number of HCPs reached and label the communication as agreed with AEMPS
f.statement: For individual safety communications to healthcare professionals, the MAH shall inform AEMPS of the number of healthcare professionals to whom the communication was made, and shall state in the communication that the text has been agreed with AEMPS and include a distinctive mark indicating the nature of the information.
f.applicability: Individual safety communications to healthcare professionals (DHPC) and RMP risk minimisation material

rows.quote: Informar a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios acerca del número de profesionales sanitarios a los que se ha realizado la comunicación. d) Identificar debidamente en la comunicación que el texto se ha acordado con la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios e incorporar un distintivo indicando la naturaleza de la información que contiene.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Inform the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices of the number of healthcare professionals to whom the communication has been made. d) Duly identify in the communication that the text has been agreed with the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices and include a distinctive mark indicating the nature of the information it contains.

f.title: Appoint a permanent PV contact person in Spain and register their details with AEMPS
f.statement: The MAH shall have in Spain, permanently and continuously, a pharmacovigilance contact person, and shall communicate this person's contact details to AEMPS through the electronic system provided for that purpose. The designated person shall have appropriate experience and training to perform the functions.

rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá disponer en España, de manera permanente y continua, de una persona de contacto en materia de farmacovigilancia, y comunicará a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios los datos de contacto de la misma a través de un sistema electrónico que se proveerá a tal efecto. La persona designada deberá poseer la experiencia y formación adecuadas para la realización de sus funciones.
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (local contact person in Spain). Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have in Spain, permanently and continuously, a contact person for pharmacovigilance, and shall communicate this person's contact details to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices through an electronic system to be provided for that purpose. The designated person shall have the appropriate experience and training to perform his or her functions.

f.title: Local contact person: support the EU QPPV and collect suspected ADRs known to company staff
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance contact person shall assist the EU QPPV in the functions entrusted and collaborate in collecting information on all suspected adverse reactions known to company personnel so it is entered in the Art. 9.1 record, ensuring accurate and verifiable information is obtained, follow-up is collected, duplicates are detected in collaboration with the Spanish PV System, and medication-error cases are properly identified.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: PV contact person in Spain (on behalf of the MAH)
rows.quote: La persona de contacto de farmacovigilancia asistirá a la persona cualificada responsable de farmacovigilancia europea referida en el artículo 8.3 en aquellas funciones que se le encomienden y colaborará en las siguientes funciones: a) Recopilar, la información sobre todas las sospechas de reacciones adversas de las que tenga conocimiento el personal de la empresa, con el fin de que dicha información se incorpore en el registro referido en el apartado 1 del artículo 9
data_elements: suspected adverse reactions known to staff
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The pharmacovigilance contact person shall assist the European qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance referred to in Article 8.3 in the functions entrusted to him or her and shall collaborate in the following functions: a) Collecting the information on all suspected adverse reactions of which the company's personnel become aware, so that this information is incorporated in the record referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 9

f.title: Local contact person: relay AEMPS requests to the QPPV and answer sales/prescription questions
f.statement: The contact person shall transmit to the EU QPPV any AEMPS request for additional information needed to evaluate a product's benefits and risks, and respond to any AEMPS request for information on the product's sales or prescription volume in Spain.

rows.actor: PV contact person in Spain (on behalf of the MAH)
rows.quote: Trasmitir a la persona responsable de farmacovigilancia de la Unión Europea referida en el artículo 8.3 cualquier solicitud de información adicional de la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios necesaria para poder evaluar los beneficios y riesgos de un medicamento y dar respuesta a cualquier informaciónque la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios le solicite relativa al volumen de ventas o de prescripciones del medicamento de que se trate en España.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Transmit to the European Union person responsible for pharmacovigilance referred to in Article 8.3 any request for additional information from the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices needed to evaluate the benefits and risks of a medicinal product, and respond to any information the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices requests regarding the volume of sales or prescriptions of the medicinal product concerned in Spain.

f.title: Local contact person: contact point for safety measures, RMP actions and inspections in Spain
f.statement: The contact person shall act as contact point to inform AEMPS about the implementation in Spain of regulatory safety measures and of RMP actions in Spain; establish the procedures needed to ensure local pharmacovigilance activities work correctly; act as contact person for pharmacovigilance inspections in Spain; and cooperate with the regional pharmacovigilance centres by providing all available information on suspected ADR reports.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Audit & inspection readiness; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: PV contact person in Spain (on behalf of the MAH)
rows.quote: Actuar como punto de contacto para proporcionar información a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios acerca de la ejecución en España de las medidas reguladoras adoptadas por razones de seguridad, así como de las acciones realizadas en España relativas a lo establecido en el plan de gestión de riesgos. d) Establecer los procedimientos necesarios que garanticen el correcto funcionamiento de las actividades locales de farmacovigilancia. e) Actuar como persona de contacto para las inspecciones de farmacovigilancia realizadas en España. f) Cooperar con los centros autonómicos de farmacovigilancia facilitando toda la información de que disponga en relación con las notificaciones de sospechas de reacciones adversas a medicamentos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Act as contact point to provide information to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices on the implementation in Spain of the regulatory measures adopted for safety reasons, as well as on the actions carried out in Spain relating to the risk management plan. d) Establish the procedures necessary to ensure the correct functioning of local pharmacovigilance activities. e) Act as contact person for pharmacovigilance inspections carried out in Spain. f) Cooperate with the regional pharmacovigilance centres by providing all the information available to it in relation to reports of suspected adverse reactions to medicinal products.

f.title: Update the MA dossier without delay through variations on new safety information
f.statement: When the MAH becomes aware of new relevant information affecting the safety of the medicinal product, it shall update the authorisation and registration dossier without delay through the variation procedures; failure to do so is grounds for suspension or revocation of the MA. These variations are subject to the corresponding fee.

rows.deadline: Without delay
rows.quote: cuando el titular de una autorización de comercialización de un medicamento conozca nueva información relevante que afecte a la seguridad de dicho medicamento, deberá actualizar sin dilación el expediente de autorización y registro, mediante los procedimientos de modificación de las condiciones de autorización de medicamentos de uso humano, siendo su incumplimiento causa de suspensión o revocación de la autorización.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: when the holder of a marketing authorisation of a medicinal product becomes aware of new relevant information affecting the safety of that medicinal product, it shall update without delay the authorisation and registration dossier, through the procedures for variation of the authorisation conditions of medicinal products for human use, failure to do so being grounds for suspension or revocation of the authorisation.

f.title: Keep product information up to date with current scientific knowledge and EU/AEMPS outcomes
f.statement: The MAH shall ensure that the product information is kept up to date with the latest scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of assessments and recommendations published on the European medicines web portal and on the AEMPS website.
f.systems: European medicines web portal; AEMPS website

rows.quote: El titular de la autorización de comercialización se asegurará de que la información del medicamento esté actualizada, en función de los últimos conocimientos científicos, entre los que se incluyen las conclusiones de las evaluaciones y las recomendaciones publicadas en el portal web europeo sobre medicamentos
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall ensure that the information on the medicinal product is up to date, in line with the latest scientific knowledge, including the conclusions of the assessments and the recommendations published on the European medicines web portal

f.title: Urgent safety restriction by the MAH: apply to AEMPS with the required documentation
f.statement: When the MAH considers an urgent change to the MA conditions necessary for safety reasons, it shall apply to AEMPS for the change, attaching a report on the risks detected, a proposed SmPC and leaflet change, a proposal for information to healthcare professionals (and, where relevant, for users), and proposed complementary actions and any other information needed for effective implementation.
f.processes: Safety labeling; Submission operations; Safety communications

rows.quote: Cuando el titular de la autorización de comercialización considere necesaria la modificación urgente de las condiciones de autorización de un medicamento por razones de seguridad, solicitará dicha modificación a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios, acompañando la siguiente documentación:
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: When the marketing authorisation holder considers necessary the urgent modification of the authorisation conditions of a medicinal product for safety reasons, it shall request that modification from the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices, accompanied by the following documentation:

f.title: Urgent safety restriction: file the SmPC variation within 15 days of provisional acceptance
f.statement: If AEMPS raises no objection within the working day following receipt of the information, the urgent safety changes are considered provisionally accepted and the MAH shall apply for the SmPC variation within fifteen calendar days from the date of acceptance.

rows.deadline: 15 calendar days from the date of (provisional) acceptance
rows.quote: el titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá solicitar la modificación de la ficha técnica en un plazo de quince días naturales desde la fecha de aceptación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: the marketing authorisation holder shall apply for the variation of the summary of product characteristics within fifteen calendar days from the date of acceptance.

deadline_rule.applies_to: SmPC variation following an MAH-initiated urgent safety restriction

f.title: AEMPS-imposed urgent safety restriction: submit the variation within 15 days of notification
f.statement: When the urgent safety change is imposed by AEMPS, the MAH shall submit a variation application in the terms set by AEMPS immediately and no later than fifteen calendar days following receipt of the AEMPS notification.

rows.deadline: Immediately and no later than 15 calendar days after receipt of the AEMPS notification
rows.quote: Cuando la modificación urgente por razones de seguridad venga impuesta por la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios, el titular de la autorización de comercialización estará obligado a presentar una solicitud de modificación en los términos que establezca la Agencia de forma inmediata y en un plazo no superior a los quince días naturales siguientes a la recepción de la notificación de la Agencia.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: When the urgent modification for safety reasons is imposed by the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices, the marketing authorisation holder shall be obliged to submit an application for variation in the terms established by the Agency immediately and within a period not exceeding the fifteen calendar days following receipt of the Agency's notification.

deadline_rule.clock_start: siguientes a la recepción de la notificación de la Agencia
deadline_rule.applies_to: variation application for an AEMPS-imposed urgent safety restriction

f.title: Agree HCP information timing and implementation of urgent safety changes with AEMPS
f.statement: For urgent safety changes (MAH-initiated or imposed), the timing and terms of the information to healthcare professionals and the effective implementation of the change by the MAH, including changes to packaging material, shall be agreed with AEMPS.

rows.quote: el plazo y los términos de la información dirigida a los profesionales sanitarios, así como la aplicación efectiva de la modificación por parte del titular, incluyendo los cambios en el material de acondicionamiento, se acordarán con la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: the time limit and terms of the information addressed to healthcare professionals, as well as the effective implementation of the change by the holder, including the changes to the packaging material, shall be agreed with the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices.

f.title: Spain-only active substances: submit the safety issue report to AEMPS within 60 days
f.statement: For safety issues affecting only products with active substances authorised solely in Spain, AEMPS will request from the MAH a report evaluating the safety issue and, where relevant, the benefit-risk balance for the conditions of use authorised in Spain, with proposed risk reduction measures, following the structure specified in the request. The report shall be submitted within a maximum of sixty calendar days of receipt of the request, unless a shorter period is set due to urgency or, exceptionally and at the MAH's request, an extension is agreed with AEMPS.
f.applicability: Medicinal products whose active substances are authorised only in Spain
f.exceptions: Shorter period for urgent issues; extension may be agreed with AEMPS in exceptional cases at the MAH's request.

rows.deadline: Maximum 60 calendar days from receipt of the request
rows.quote: El informe deberá ser remitido en el plazo máximo de sesenta días naturales desde la recepción de la solicitud, a menos que por la urgencia del problema se establezca un plazo menor, o en casos excepcionales y a petición del titular, se acuerde con la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios una ampliación de este plazo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The report shall be submitted within a maximum of sixty calendar days from receipt of the request, unless a shorter period is set because of the urgency of the problem, or in exceptional cases and at the request of the holder, an extension of this period is agreed with the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices.

deadline_rule.clock_start: desde la recepción de la solicitud
deadline_rule.applies_to: MAH safety issue report requested by AEMPS (Spain-only active substances)

f.title: Apply for MA variations required by EU urgent procedure outcomes
f.statement: Following the indications published by AEMPS (SmPC and leaflet changes and implementation calendar) after an EU urgent procedure, the MAH shall apply for the appropriate variation of the MA conditions under the procedures of Royal Decree 1345/2007.
f.exceptions: Not applicable to centrally authorised products (Art. 20.4).

rows.deadline: According to the implementation calendar
rows.quote: De conformidad con dichas indicaciones, el titular de la autorización de comercialización deberá solicitar la oportuna modificación de las condiciones de autorización del medicamento
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: In accordance with those indications, the marketing authorisation holder shall apply for the appropriate variation of the authorisation conditions of the medicinal product

f.title: Submit the safety variation even when AEMPS has already published the updated SmPC
f.statement: AEMPS may publish SmPCs and leaflets with safety changes decided in EU urgent procedures before the MAH has submitted the variation; this publication does not exempt the MAH from submitting the corresponding variation application.

rows.quote: Esta publicación no eximirá a éste en ningún caso de presentar la solicitud de modificación correspondiente.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: This publication shall in no case exempt the holder from submitting the corresponding variation application.

f.title: Guarantee confidentiality and personal data protection in PV data processing
f.statement: In the computerised and electronic processing of data from pharmacovigilance activities, confidentiality, personal and family privacy of citizens and protection of their personal data shall be guaranteed in accordance with the applicable data protection legislation.
f.clause: Disposición adicional primera. Protección de datos

rows.actor: All parties processing pharmacovigilance data (including MAHs)
rows.quote: en el tratamiento informático de los datos derivados del desarrollo de las actividades de farmacovigilancia así como su proceso electrónico, deberá quedar garantizada, conforme previene la normativa específica de aplicación, la confidencialidad, la intimidad personal y familiar de los ciudadanos y la protección de sus datos de carácter personal.
rows.location: Disposición adicional primera. Protección de datos
rows.review_note: Review: the provision binds all processors of PV data; MAH applicability inferred. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: in the computerised processing of data deriving from pharmacovigilance activities as well as their electronic processing, the confidentiality, personal and family privacy of citizens and the protection of their personal data shall be guaranteed, as provided by the specific applicable legislation.

f.title: Transitional: before EudraVigilance functionalities, send serious Spanish ADRs to the Spanish PV System
f.statement: Art. 9.3 applies from six months after the EudraVigilance functionalities are established. Until then, MAHs shall send electronically to the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System only the serious suspected adverse reactions reported by healthcare professionals or citizens; serious suspected ADRs occurring outside the EU shall be sent electronically to EudraVigilance by the MAH; non-serious reactions are not sent during this transitional period.
f.applicability: Transitional period until six months after EudraVigilance functionalities were established (the date is announced by AEMPS, not stated in the text)

rows.quote: Hasta ese momento, los titulares de la autorización de comercialización enviarán de forma electrónica al Sistema Español de Farmacovigilancia únicamente las sospechas de reacciones adversas graves notificadas por los profesionales sanitarios o los ciudadanos al Sistema Español de Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: transitional rule, spent once the EudraVigilance centralised reporting date announced by AEMPS passed; kept for completeness. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Until that time, marketing authorisation holders shall send electronically to the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System only the serious suspected adverse reactions reported by healthcare professionals or citizens to the Spanish Pharmacovigilance System.

f.title: Transitional: send PSURs electronically to AEMPS until the EU repository applies
f.statement: Art. 10.1 applies from twelve months after the PSUR repository functionalities are established. Until then, MAHs shall send PSURs to AEMPS electronically through the application created for that purpose, meeting the requirements of the previous legislation.
f.applicability: Transitional period until twelve months after the PSUR repository functionalities were established

rows.quote: Hasta ese momento, los titulares de autorización de comercialización deberán enviar los informes periódicos de seguridad a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios de forma electrónica y a través de la aplicación creada a tal efecto, cumpliendo con los requisitos exigidos por la normativa anterior vigente.
rows.review_note: Review: transitional rule, spent once the PSUR repository became mandatory; kept for completeness. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: Until that time, marketing authorisation holders shall send the periodic safety update reports to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices electronically and through the application created for that purpose, complying with the requirements of the previous legislation in force.

f.title: Communicate PV contact person details to AEMPS and regional authorities until the online application exists
f.statement: Registration and update of the PV contact person's identification details (Art. 14.1) shall be done online once AEMPS announces the enabling application; until then MAHs shall communicate these data to AEMPS and to the competent bodies of the autonomous communities concerned.

rows.quote: El registro y actualización de los datos identificativos de la persona de contacto de farmacovigilancia contemplado en el apartado 1 del artículo 14 se realizará por vía telemática una vez la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios haga publica la habilitación de una aplicación para tal efecto. Hasta ese momento, los titulares de autorización de comercialización deberán comunicar estos datos a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios, y a los órganos competentes de las comunidades autónomas correspondientes.
rows.review_note: Review: online registration and update duty is ongoing; the interim channel is transitional. Double-check: quote proves duty; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: The registration and update of the identification details of the pharmacovigilance contact person referred to in Article 14(1) shall be carried out electronically once the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices announces the enabling of an application for that purpose. Until then, marketing authorisation holders shall communicate these data to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices and to the competent bodies of the autonomous communities concerned.

f.title: PSMF for products authorised before the decree: at MA renewal and before 21 July 2015
f.statement: For medicinal products authorised before the decree entered into force, the MAH's obligation to have and maintain a PSMF and submit its summary (Art. 8) shall be fulfilled at MA renewal or in any case before 21 July 2015.

rows.deadline: At MA renewal or before 21 July 2015
