rows.quote: Para los medicamentos autorizados antes de la entrada en vigor del presente real decreto, la obligación por parte del titular de autorización de comercialización de disponer y mantener un archivo maestro del sistema de farmacovigilancia y de presentar el resumen del mismo establecida en el artículo 8, se realizará en el momento de la renovación de la autorización de comercialización o en todo caso, con anterioridad al 21 de julio de 2015.
rows.review_note: Review: rule date is the stated limit ('before 21 July 2015'). Double-check: quote proves duty and date; bilingual re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: For medicinal products authorised before the entry into force of this royal decree, the obligation of the marketing authorisation holder to have and maintain a pharmacovigilance system master file and to submit its summary, established in Article 8, shall be fulfilled at the time of renewal of the marketing authorisation or in any case before 21 July 2015.

deadline_rule.clock_start: con anterioridad al 21 de julio de 2015
deadline_rule.applies_to: PSMF and summary for products authorised before the decree entered into force

f.title: Special-situation medicines: notify suspected ADRs to AEMPS immediately
f.statement: Final provision one amends Art. 11(1)(c) of Royal Decree 1015/2009 (availability of medicines in special situations) to read: notify suspected adverse reactions to AEMPS immediately.
f.legal_basis: RD 1015/2009 Art. 11.1(c) as amended by RD 577/2013 DF 1ª
f.applicability: Medicines made available under RD 1015/2009 (compassionate use, medicines not authorised in Spain, off-label use)

rows.actor: Party bound by Art. 11(1) of RD 1015/2009 (medicines in special situations)
rows.deadline: Immediately
rows.quote: «c) Notificar de forma inmediata las sospechas de reacciones adversas a la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios.»
rows.review_note: Review: the actor of RD 1015/2009 Art. 11(1) is not stated in this text; kept generic. Double-check: quote proves the amended duty; actor unresolved, so below 90.
rows.quote_en: "c) Notify suspected adverse reactions immediately to the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices."

f.title: Treat medically important ADRs and suspected transmission of infectious agents as serious
f.statement: For reporting purposes, suspected adverse reactions considered medically important, even if not meeting the seriousness criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalisation or prolongation, significant or persistent disability, congenital anomaly), such as those putting the patient at risk or requiring intervention to prevent one of those outcomes, and all suspected transmission of an infectious agent via a medicinal product, shall also be treated as serious.

rows.quote: A efectos de su notificación, se tratarán también como graves aquellas sospechas de reacción adversa que se consideren importantes desde el punto de vista médico, aunque no cumplan los criterios anteriores, como las que ponen en riesgo al paciente o requieren una intervención para prevenir alguno de los desenlaces anteriores y todas las sospechas de transmisión de un agente infeccioso a través de un medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: For reporting purposes, suspected adverse reactions considered important from a medical point of view shall also be treated as serious, even if they do not meet the above criteria, such as those that put the patient at risk or require an intervention to prevent one of the above outcomes, and all suspected transmissions of an infectious agent via a medicinal product.

f.title: Treat medication errors causing harm as adverse reactions
f.statement: Medication errors that cause harm to the patient are considered adverse reactions, except those arising from therapeutic failure due to omission of a treatment.
f.exceptions: Therapeutic failure due to omission of a treatment.

rows.quote: Los errores de medicación que ocasionen un daño en el paciente se consideran reacciones adversas, excepto aquellos derivados del fallo terapéutico por omisión de un tratamiento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Medication errors that cause harm to the patient are considered adverse reactions, except those deriving from therapeutic failure due to omission of a treatment.

dates.title: Spain Royal Decree 577/2013 on pharmacovigilance: enters into force
dates.scope: Pharmacovigilance of medicinal products for human use in Spain (MAHs, health administrations, healthcare professionals, citizens)
dates.quote: El presente real decreto entrará en vigor el día siguiente al de su publicación en el «Boletín Oficial del Estado».
dates.quote_en: This royal decree shall enter into force on the day following its publication in the Official State Gazette (BOE).
dates.location: Disposición final sexta. Entrada en vigor
dates.timing_note: Published in BOE no. 179 on 2013-07-27 (header) + 1 day = 2013-07-28.

dates.title: Spain RD 577/2013: PSMF required for products authorised before entry into force
dates.scope: MAHs of medicinal products authorised before the decree entered into force: PSMF and its summary (Art. 8), at MA renewal and in any case before 21 July 2015
dates.quote: se realizará en el momento de la renovación de la autorización de comercialización o en todo caso, con anterioridad al 21 de julio de 2015.
dates.quote_en: shall be fulfilled at the time of renewal of the marketing authorisation or in any case before 21 July 2015.
dates.location: Disposición transitoria cuarta. Archivo maestro de farmacovigilancia
dates.timing_note: The text says 'before 21 July 2015' (con anterioridad al); the date recorded is the stated limit, so the PSMF had to be in place by 20 July 2015 at the latest, or earlier at renewal.
